title: Scrape web pages to a sheet

goal.label: What to collect, one row per what

seed.label: Start URL, sitemap or search query

sheet.label: Google Sheet id to append to

steps.title: Define the columns
steps.prompt:
Goal: {{inputs.goal}}

Write {{run.dir}}/schema.json: the columns and their types for one row, plus source_url and fetched_at. Keep it to what the goal needs.

steps.title: Find the pages
steps.prompt: Turn {{inputs.seed}} into a list of page URLs that hold rows for {{run.dir}}/schema.json: read the sitemap, follow the site's own links, or search. Write {{run.dir}}/urls.json as a list of URLs, no duplicates. Set count to how many.

steps.title: Fetch and extract
steps.prompt: Take every fourth URL in {{run.dir}}/urls.json starting at position {{index}} (counting from 0). Fetch each page; open it in your browser pane when it needs JavaScript. Stop and note the URL on a CAPTCHA or login wall. Extract rows matching {{run.dir}}/schema.json; leave unknown fields empty, never guess. Write {{run.dir}}/rows-{{index}}.json and list failed URLs under failed.

steps.title: Clean and spot-check
steps.prompt: Merge {{run.dir}}/rows-*.json into {{run.dir}}/rows.csv: check types against {{run.dir}}/schema.json and remove duplicates. Re-open 5 random rows' source pages and confirm the values. Write {{run.dir}}/validate.md. Set passed to false when a spot-checked value is wrong. Set rows to how many rows the CSV has.

steps.title: Approve writing the sheet
steps.gate_summary: {{steps.validate.outputs.rows}} rows in {{run.dir}}/rows.csv, spot-check passed: {{steps.validate.outputs.passed}}. Approve to append them to sheet {{inputs.sheet}}.

steps.title: Append to the sheet
steps.prompt: Append every row in {{run.dir}}/rows.csv to Google Sheet {{inputs.sheet}}, matching columns by name. Do not change rows already there. Set appended to how many rows were added.
